routes.title: Spedizione dei Mille, 1860
routes.summary: Garibaldi's Thousand left Quarto dei Mille on 5 May 1860, landed at Marsala on 11 May, and entered Naples on 7 September. The campaign closed with the meeting at Teano on 26 October 1860.

routes.title: L'esilio di Dante
routes.summary: Dante received his sentence of exile in Firenze on 27 January 1302 and died in Ravenna in 1321. The stops predate 1563, so each pin uses the 1563 jurisdiction of that place.

stops.label: Last years in Ravenna. Dante dies here in 1321

routes.title: Dal Veneto a Buenos Aires
routes.summary: A northern emigration route from Udine in Austrian Lombardo-Veneto through Genova to the Hotel de Inmigrantes in Buenos Aires, 1858–1888. On 1 July 1866 Udine was still Lombardo-Veneto. The plebiscite followed on 21 October 1866.
